spec.description: On-call triage view for Prod App A: golden signals first (traffic, errors, latency), then node saturation, then per-container detail.

spec.title: 5xx Error Rate
spec.description: Share of HTTP responses returning 5xx. Yellow >1%, red >5%.

spec.title: Request Rate (total)
spec.description: Total inbound HTTP request rate across all opentelemetry-demo services.

spec.title: p95 Latency (now)
spec.description: 95th percentile HTTP server duration across all services. Yellow >300ms, red >1s.

spec.title: p99 Latency (now)
spec.description: 99th percentile HTTP server duration across all services. Yellow >500ms, red >2s.

spec.title: 5xx Error Rate by Service
spec.description: Per-service 5xx ratio over time. Use with Request Rate to tell a real spike from low-traffic noise.

spec.expr:
label_replace(
  100
  * (
      sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"opentelemetry-demo/.*", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m]))
      or
      0 * sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"opentelemetry-demo/.*"}[5m]))
    )
  / sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"opentelemetry-demo/.*"}[5m])),
  "svc", "$1", "job", "opentelemetry-demo/(.*)"
)

spec.title: Container CPU Usage (top 10)
spec.description: Top 10 containers by CPU. Trimmed with topk() so the chart stays readable.

spec.title: Prod App A - Application & Infrastructure Overview
